content: Self-pairing on my leader, so pure decoration. Everything structural is already where I want it: conjugated anilide NH, para pyridin-2-ylamino with the ring nitrogen ortho to a free donor NH, monocyclic azine, ortho fluorine, MW 245. The remaining inefficiency is that at 245 Da the molecule sits below the band QED rewards most, so a small addition can buy drug-likeness rather than cost it, provided it does not touch either NH. Atom 11 is the pyridine C4 position - an unsubstituted ring CH, well away from both donors and from the ring nitrogen at atom 14 - so a methyl there is the cheapest possible elaboration: it adds 14 Da, costs nothing in SA since ring methylation is trivially accessible, adds no rotatable bond of consequence and leaves TPSA untouched at 54. Alkyl substitution on the azine is also common in this chemotype, so there is a reasonable chance it is tolerated or favoured on activity as well.
